Three commits on the branch — initial scenario set, merge of main, then S7–S12 expansion. Summary:

## What this turn produced

### Merge from main
Clean merge — no conflicts. Pulled in 11 commits covering net-of-borrowing fixes, the `GoalCalculationService` extraction, the `Loan Share` UI rename, the 3-bucket fund summary (`Allocated` / `Loaned` / `Available unallocated`), the `CreditLineDelayNotification` persisted-dedup ledger, partial-credit accounting fixes, and the four new `AccountExt` gross/net/borrowed accessors.

### Post-merge scenario fixes
- **S1/S4**: `'Credit Line #'` → `'Loan Share #'` (label rename from commit c79126a6)
- **S5**: un-skipped the goal-progress test; rewrote it to assert the `GoalCalculationService` contract directly (`current`=net, `current_gross`=legacy, `borrowed_value` surfaces the delta). The memory `goal-current-is-net` is now load-bearing on shipped code.

### 6 new feature scenarios + 2 new Dusk smokes
| # | Asserts |
|---|---|
| **S7** | Lending leaves AUM/share-price untouched; 3-bucket sum reconciles to fund total; borrowing shifts between buckets without growing the total. |
| **S8** | Across the lifecycle, `sharesWithoutBorrowing − borrowed = net` (and same triangle for value). |
| **S9** | `ScanLatePaymentsJob` run twice same-day produces exactly 1 `CreditLineDelayNotification` row per payment; subsequent run after `repeat_days` fires #2; disabling the flag suppresses all sends. Scoped per-payment because pool4's shared dev DB has pre-existing late payments. |
| **S10** | Row stays `PARTIAL` through three 1/3-share REPs, flips to `PAID` only when allocations sum to `shares_due`; later rows stay `SCHEDULED`. |
| **S11** | Reversing an old REP re-opens only the row it had settled; later REPs and their allocations are untouched; outstanding climbs back. |
| **S12** | Drawing in Fund A leaves every Fund B metric byte-identical (AUM, share price, all four buckets, beneficiary balance, account_balances rows). |

Dusk smokes (run from `familyfund` container post-merge): S7 fund summary stripe renders the "Loaned" bucket; S9 loan-share show page renders the `Late` row state for a backdated line.

### Test counts
- **Scenarios**: 32 tests, 161 assertions, all pass (12 scenario classes)
- **Full credit-line regression** (`CreditLineFlowTest`, `CreditLineMessyHistoryTest`, `Unit/Services/CreditLine`): 156 tests pass, no regression
- 1 deliberately-skipped test: none anymore

### Memory updates
- `share-loan-rename`: corrected the recorded name to **"Loan Share"** (what shipped) — labels only; classes/tables/routes still use `credit_line`.
- `transaction-observer-wiring-gap`: still valid after merge (verified `AppServiceProvider` still calls `Transaction::observe(...)`).

### Discoveries worth flagging
- **Observer wiring gap persists** in main — no production save fires the credit-line detection pipeline; only direct `CreditLineClassifier::classify($tran)` works. Worth a dedicated fix.
- **`delay_notification_enabled` is a real column but not in `AccountCreditLine::$fillable`** — tests had to use `forceFill`/direct `update()`. Probably worth adding to fillable.
- **PHPUnit feature tests on pool4 see the shared dev DB**, so any assertion on global counts (mail, late payments, etc.) is unreliable. Future scenarios should scope assertions per-account/per-line.
